mcq.q: 10 M registered users means you need…
options: Unknown until you know active usage, peaks and task duration
mcq.why: Load comes from active users, peak behaviour and request cost, not registrations.

mcq.q: 50 RPS with 8 s average time in system gives about how many in flight?
mcq.why: Little's law: L = λW = 50 × 8 (an average, not a p99).
